description: UsageRail is an API monetization platform for teams that sell an API. It adds API keys, rate limits, quotas, usage metering, a hosted developer portal, and Stripe-based billing to an existing API.
summary: UsageRail exposes two documented HTTP APIs on `api.usagerail.com` (the server API and the HTTP check endpoint) plus two tenant-hosted widget surfaces on `{your-app}.usagerail.app` (an authenticated usage widget and a public pricing-table script); no GraphQL API, MCP server, or CLI was found.
